stem: What conclusion can the reader make based on both the story and the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: People enjoy the experience of finding hidden objects or messages.

options.label: B
options.text: It is important to follow instructions that are included with messages.

options.label: C
options.text: People can become friends with someone whom they have never met.

options.label: D
options.text: It is common to find objects that have been left in secret places.
